Tangled kelp, a splintered oar, and there, wedged between two stones, a green bottle sealed with wax. Inside was a single page, the ink blurred but readable. It was written by a boy on a freighter, forty miles out, who said he was frightened and wanted someone to know he had seen the light. Tomas read it three times. Then he went up the tower, lit the lamp early, and wrote back on the blank side of the page, though he knew no answer could ever find its way home.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在薄雾里拉出一圈圈昏黄的光，街道空得能听见自己的脚步声。远处，环卫工人推着扫帚，沙沙地划过地面，像在翻动一本很长的书。便利店的玻璃门还亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。高楼的窗口大多黑着，只有零星几盏灯，不知是谁在熬夜，又是谁刚刚醒来。天边还没有一丝白，但空气里已经有了早晨的凉意。送奶车缓缓驶过路口，红灯独自闪着，没有人等它变绿。这是一天中最诚实的时刻，城市卸下喧嚣，露出疲倦而温柔的脸。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one, find a smaller doll, and keep opening until you reach the tiniest one.\n- You must have a stopping point, like the last doll, or you would open dolls forever."}
